decision_impact.title: Rainfall changed crop water needs
decision_impact.detail: Rainfall -20% moved effective rainfall from 177 to 141 mm and the seasonal deviation from -21.1% to -36.9% (fuzzy set deficit → deficit). Groundnut's irrigation need per hectare changed +15.0% (2,353,200 → 2,706,600 L/ha).

decision_impact.title: Water availability changed the irrigation risk
decision_impact.detail: Storage 62.0% → 25.0% (fuzzy set medium → low); irrigation risk 0.465 → 0.684.

decision_impact.title: Crop suitability (fuzzy confidence) changed
decision_impact.detail: Per-crop yield confidence scales expected yield in the optimiser: most affected Tapioca 0.518 → 0.328 (-36.7%; rainfall dependency High); least affected Paddy 0.601 → 0.414 (-31.1%; rainfall dependency Low).

decision_impact.title: Priorities changed how TOPSIS picks from the Pareto front
decision_impact.detail: The dominant TOPSIS weight moved from expected yield (0.30) to irrigation water (0.40). NSGA-II itself has no weights; they decide which Pareto plan is recommended.

decision_impact.title: Maize gained land
decision_impact.detail: the optimiser moved Maize from 7.1% to 58.2% of the land on average over 5 runs (+51.1 pp, p = 0.000). Under the scenario its irrigation need +11.1%/ha, confidence -31.1%/ha. It fared better than Tapioca on confidence.

decision_impact.title: Tapioca lost land
decision_impact.detail: the optimiser moved Tapioca from 85.2% to 40.5% of the land on average over 5 runs (-44.7 pp, p = 0.001). Under the scenario its irrigation need +5.5%/ha, confidence -36.7%/ha.

decision_impact.title: Some shifts are within search variation
decision_impact.detail: Groundnut -6.4 pp (p = 0.15). These moves are not consistent across the seed runs, so the optimiser's own randomness could explain them; they are not attributed to the scenario.

decision_impact.title: The baseline plan under the new conditions
decision_impact.detail: Kept unchanged, the baseline plan's irrigation water would change +6.0%; re-optimising changes it a further -22.5%.

sentences: Scenario for Salem Kharif: rainfall -20%; water availability Low; optimisation priorities custom (0.30 / 0.20 / 0.40 / 0.10).
The recommended plan moved from Tapioca 91%, Maize 3%, Groundnut 5% to Tapioca 42%, Maize 54%, Groundnut 4%; across 5 runs the shift is consistent for Tapioca, Maize.
Expected yield -57.2%, production cost -12.2%, irrigation water -17.9%, environmental impact +15.5%, indicative profit -55.7% (mean of 5 runs).
Alignment with the district's observed cropping pattern: 27.5% → 44.5%.
summary.text: Scenario for Salem Kharif: rainfall -20%; water availability Low; optimisation priorities custom (0.30 / 0.20 / 0.40 / 0.10). The recommended plan moved from Tapioca 91%, Maize 3%, Groundnut 5% to Tapioca 42%, Maize 54%, Groundnut 4%; across 5 runs the shift is consistent for Tapioca, Maize. Expected yield -57.2%, production cost -12.2%, irrigation water -17.9%, environmental impact +15.5%, indicative profit -55.7% (mean of 5 runs). Recommendation confidence 73.6% → 68.4%. Alignment with the district's observed cropping pattern: 27.5% → 44.5%.
